title: Grant console worker permission for CloudWatch data protection policy
description:
ConsoleChatResponder Lambda fails in sandbox with AccessDenied on logs:PutDataProtectionPolicy when cloudwatch_logger attempts to apply data masking policy to /plexus/procedures/* log groups.

Fix scope:
- Add missing IAM action to ConsoleChatResponder role policy in Amplify stack
- Keep resource scope limited to procedure log groups
- Validate amplify TypeScript compile

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Implemented fix in `dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/resource.ts`:

- Added `logs:PutDataProtectionPolicy` to ConsoleChatResponder IAM policy for `/plexus/procedures/*` log group resources.

Validation:
- `cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit -p amplify/tsconfig.json` passed.
